research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 10347 of April 18, 1952, 17 FR 3521 (Apr. 22, 1952), held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10347.txt; it authorizes and directs the Secretary of State to affix the Seal of the United States, without any special warrant other than the order, to six classes of documents signed by the President. Later instruments: EO 11354 sec. 3 (May 23, 1967, effective July 1, 1967 under its sec. 5) restated item 1; EO 11517 sec. 3 (Mar. 19, 1970) deleted numbered paragraph 4 and renumbered 5 and 6 as 4 and 5. Searches of the held corpus for the order number (cruden.py, jobs/later-events EDGES.csv) found only these two amending orders and the 1989 OFR codification line; the OFR catalog notes record amendment by EO 11354 and EO 11517. No held note says Revoked by or Superseded by. Current law: the U.S. Code note to 4 U.S.C. 42 prints the order as amended by both orders with no ending statement; no eCFR text cites it. Authority statutes 3 U.S.C. 301 and 4 U.S.C. 42 are in force in the held current texts. Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).
